items.title: Pat Freiermuth: Active in Week 10
items.text:
Freiermuth (illness) is active for Sunday's game at Cincinnati, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Three more TDs in loss
items.text:
Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cade Klubnik: Steps in after Geno's injury
items.text:
Klubnik completed 11 of 20 passes for 137 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills. He added three rushing attempts for 26 yards.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Harold Fannin: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text:
Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Quinshon Judkins: Gets into end zone Sunday
items.text:
Judkins rushed 10 times for 38 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of five targets for 33 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
